note: Generated by tools/makeLevels.js from the run in docs/teaching.html. Every seed is a board greedy play can clear the target on, so no level ships unwinnable. Edit the run in the doc and regenerate; editing this file alone makes the two disagree and the tests say so.

levels.teaches: A glyph on its own color activates
levels.note: At two colors every glyph is the opposite of its cell, so every swap that lands at all is a double hit. The player cannot fail to see the rule.

levels.teaches: You move glyphs, not cells
levels.note: Same trivial palette, so attention is on what moved. The ground stays put and the shape travels.

levels.teaches: Any two cells swap — the whole board is in reach
levels.note: Put the only two useful pieces in opposite corners. A rule taught by letting the move work is cheaper than one taught by refusing it.

levels.teaches: A swap can miss
levels.note: The third color is where choosing begins — two openings in three now pay once instead of twice.

levels.teaches: The cell is gone; the board drains, and the budget bites
levels.note: First level where a wasted swap costs the target. Set it high enough that the player runs the board low and feels it thin out.

levels.teaches: Activating shoves its neighbors
levels.note: One pusher, hand-placed, in an otherwise inert board. The player should see exactly one thing move.

levels.teaches: A shoved glyph can activate — the combo
levels.note: Author this one; a random board rarely chains this early.

levels.teaches: A glyph shoved off the edge is gone
levels.note: The first sink, framed as a loss. It becomes a tool in Act III.

levels.teaches: A shove leaves an empty cell — and you can move into it
levels.note: The board could not offer this before pushers existed. Author a board whose only line needs a piece parked in a hole a shove just opened.

levels.teaches: Side count is the verb — circle radiates, triangle points
levels.note: Two shapes only; the other four have nothing to contrast against yet.

levels.teaches: Rotation is the direction
levels.note: Four triangles, four headings, one board.

levels.teaches: Fill is magnitude — how far it shoves
levels.note: Hollow, half, solid side by side so the ramp reads at a glance.

levels.teaches: Nothing — first real test
levels.note: Above the measured mean, so it needs a chain rather than six clean singles.

levels.teaches: The square eats what is shoved into it
levels.note: One eater, placed where the player will push into it by accident.

levels.teaches: The eater takes the front of the line
levels.note: The ABCD case, staged literally: A eats, D fires, the player watches B disappear and C step into its place.

levels.teaches: Feeding an eater on purpose
levels.note: The turn from hazard to tool. Author a board where the only line runs through one.

levels.teaches: The inner mark is targeting — ⊞ orthogonal, ⊠ diagonal
levels.note: Third primitive. The two marks side by side make the distinction self-evident.

levels.teaches: Nesting is range — it acts at distance two
levels.note: Fourth and last primitive. Everything after this is combination, not new rules.

levels.teaches: ⊘ Void pulls its four neighbors inward
levels.note: Stage it on a cross: the player watches four glyphs fall in and two get eaten. The mirror of a push, and the first ability that compacts rather than scatters.

levels.teaches: Pulling on purpose — compacting the rim
levels.note: A board whose only line needs material dragged inward before it connects.

levels.teaches: Thirty moves show two matches; one of them pays
levels.note: The reach rule's bill, presented plainly. Not a lure and a line — a field of identical-looking moves with one line hidden in it.

levels.teaches: The greedy read costs you
levels.note: Now the shape the generator is good at: the tempting move is not merely average, it is actively poor.

levels.teaches: The palette opens
levels.note: Matches get rarer; the same swap budget now has to be spent well.

levels.teaches: The winning move looks worse
levels.note: The inverted case — the line shows one match, thirty others show two.

levels.teaches: Nothing — the full set, unassisted
levels.note: Well above the mean of 13.1. Reachable only by finding a line.
